*Saraṇaduka, Maggārammaṇattika* (Patthana 15.85) is a canonical Abhidhamma text located within the Paṭṭhāna division of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As indicated by its title, the text belongs to the combinatorial analysis of conditional relations in the Paṭṭhāna, examining the intersection of the *Saraṇaduka* (the dyad of *saraṇa*) and the *Maggārammaṇattika* (the triad of *maggārammaṇa*) [SuttaCentral].
No external cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are identified for this text [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records no curated parallels, but automated alignment by DharmaNexus reveals extensive Pali-internal text reuse, detecting 87 matching passages shared across 38 other Pali texts [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. These reuses occur with related analytical sections of the Paṭṭhāna, most prominently *Saraṇaduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.14, with segment ranges §1.1–3.1 aligning with §58.1–62.1), *Saraṇaduka, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 18.29, sharing §1.1–3.1 with §2.1–4.1), *Kusalattika, Tika* (Patthana 5.1), *Sārammaṇaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.38), and the preceding section *Saraṇaduka, Micchattaniyatattika* (Patthana 15.84) [DharmaNexus].
